description: An assistant principal must approve an after-school student culinary showcase and finalize the room, food-safety supervision, and allergy protections, with input from the culinary arts teacher and school nurse.

shared_context.S1: The student culinary club plans an after-school tasting showcase for families in three weeks.
shared_context.S2: Ms. Brooks must give the final approval for the event and its operating plan.
shared_context.S3: The club has proposed using one of the school's culinary teaching rooms and serving prepared food to visitors.
shared_context.S4: Under the school's routine activity-approval policy, this type of event requires findings only from the culinary facilities and food-safety reviewer and the health-services reviewer; after both findings are submitted, Ms. Brooks records their sources and signs the approval.

PF1.text: Kitchen 2 is the only available room with a currently inspected commercial hood and the required handwashing station for a public tasting; Mr. Shah confirmed this against the facilities inspection log yesterday, but the club's planning form still lists Kitchen 1. District policy also requires a food-handler-certified adult to supervise public food service, and Mr. Shah holds the current certification.

PF2.text: A participating student has a documented anaphylactic allergy to peanuts and tree nuts. The student's health plan requires that no peanut or tree-nut ingredients be used, two epinephrine kits be present at the event, and an adult trained in epinephrine administration be assigned; Nurse Morgan reviewed the current health plan this week, but the event health form has not yet been updated.

acceptance_conditions: The showcase must be approved only with Kitchen 2 as the event room.
A currently food-handler-certified adult must be assigned to supervise public food service.
The menu must exclude all peanut and tree-nut ingredients.
Two epinephrine kits must be present at the event.
An adult trained in epinephrine administration must be assigned.
The room, food-safety supervision, and health protections must be documented in formal commitments.

content_checks.C4: decisions.get('food_service_supervisor') == 'Mr. Shah' or any(c.get('type') in ['supervision', 'supervisor_designation', 'supervisor_assignment'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C5: decisions.get('ingredients_restricted') in ['No peanut or tree-nut ingredients', 'no peanut or tree-nut ingredients'] or any(c.get('type') in ['ingredient_restriction', 'ingredient_review'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any(c.get('type') in ['allergy_emergency_plan', 'form_update', 'health_form_update'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The room changes from Kitchen 1 to Kitchen 2, and the food-service supervisor changes to Mr. Shah because Kitchen 2 alone has the inspected hood and handwashing station and Mr. Shah is the certified adult.

The health plan changes the menu to no peanuts or tree nuts, sets the exact number of epinephrine kits to two, requires a trained adult, and adds the health-form or allergy-plan documentation commitment.
